last_action: Finished and shipped the Physarum (slime mold) simulation (/slime.html): a client-side agent model where thousands of blind agents each sense the trail ahead, steer toward the strongest reading, step forward, and deposit more trail; the trail map then diffuses and decays and a living transport network self-assembles. Five presets (Network/Web/Veins/Swirl/Sparkle), drag-to-paint food that attracts, repels, or seeds trail, six palettes, and a seed-based share link that reproduces the exact network (verified deterministic across two fresh loads to within 0.004%). Wired into nav, sitemap, API manifest, self-check, and the Work list; bumped SITE_VERSION to 4.3. Validated end-to-end in a real browser (loop runs, network is one fully-connected filament structure, no JS errors).
